title: Running on Viking
text: can directly source config file exec command. path script needs visible container, simplest located within directory assigned via --bind. can use run eddy4R job using .job file similar :
code: apptainer exec --bind /users/<usr>/scratch:/scratch /mnt/longship/users/<usr>/eddy4r.york Rscript '/scratch/config.R' #!/usr/bin/env bash #SBATCH --job-name=my_job               # Job name #SBATCH --partition=nodes               # What partition the job should run on #SBATCH --time=0-00:15:00               # Time limit (DD-HH:MM:SS) #SBATCH --ntasks=1                      # Number of MPI tasks to request #SBATCH --cpus-per-task=1               # Number of CPU cores per MPI task #SBATCH --mem=1G                        # Total memory to request #SBATCH --account=dept-proj-year        # Project account to use #SBATCH --mail-type=END,FAIL            # Mail events (NONE, BEGIN, END, FAIL, ALL) #SBATCH --mail-user=abc123@york.ac.uk   # Where to send mail #SBATCH --output=%x_log/%x-%j.log       # Standard output log #SBATCH --error=%x_err/%x-%j.err        # Standard error log  # Abort if any command fails set -e  # Purge any previously loaded modules module purge  # Load modules ml Apptainer/latest  # run container apptainer exec --bind /users/<usr>/scratch:/scratch /mnt/longship/users/<usr>/eddy4r.york Rscript '/scratch/config.R'

title: Running on Viking
text: benefit running eddy4R container parallelisation reasonably straight forward. run one container per aggregation period, can done modifying para$files contain relevant aggregation period. Depending files may require pre calculation aggregation periods. example assume 1:1 match input file aggregation period - .e. calculating 1 hourly fluxes 1 hourly input files, exceptions - need pre calculate aggregation periods. Modify config script name analysis input file, passed FILE_SELECT environment variable. make container write folder avoid conflicts. def.para() run, edit para$files contain desired input file. , configure array job similar : [!IMPORTANT] must ammend --array=0-23%10 match number containers expect spawn. processing 24 hours data 10 jobs time. filter input files using $SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID pass container using --env, avalible R via Sys.getenv(). [!NOTE] can adjust --time argument greater close time expect container take run. hourly input files around 1 min, may wish test advance. can trigger job via sbatch usual.
code: para = eddy4R.york::def.para(   ...   analysis = stringr::str_remove(Sys.getenv("FILE_SELECT"), ".csv"),   ...   )  para$files = para$files[para$files %in% Sys.getenv("fileSelect")]  eddy4R.york::wrap.towr(para) #!/usr/bin/env bash #SBATCH --job-name=my_job               # Job name #SBATCH --partition=nodes               # What partition the job should run on #SBATCH --time=0-00:01:00               # Time limit (DD-HH:MM:SS) #SBATCH --ntasks=1                      # Number of MPI tasks to request #SBATCH --cpus-per-task=1               # Number of CPU cores per MPI task #SBATCH --mem=1G                        # Total memory to request #SBATCH --account=dept-proj-year        # Project account to use #SBATCH --mail-type=END,FAIL            # Mail events (NONE, BEGIN, END, FAIL, ALL) #SBATCH --mail-user=abc123@york.ac.uk   # Where to send mail #SBATCH --output=%x_log/%x-%j.log       # Standard output log #SBATCH --error=%x_err/%x-%j.err        # Standard error log #SBATCH --array=0-23%10  # Abort if any command fails set -e  # Purge any previously loaded modules module purge  # Load modules ml Apptainer/latest  # Filter the input files based on the array ID FILES=(/users/<usr>/scratch/in/*) FULLFILE=${FILES[$SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID]} FILE=$(basename -- "$FULLFILE")  # run container apptainer exec --env FILE_SELECT=${FILE} --bind /users/<usr>/scratch:/scratch /mnt/longship/users/<usr>/eddy4r.york Rscript '/scratch/eddy4R/testdata/test_config2.R'

title: eddy4R.york
text: eddy4R.york R package extends eddy4R providing features helpers used build WACL-York flux workflows. major feature allows flux workflows defined relatively short configuration scripts, making simple iterate parameters used, maintaining reproducibility.

title: eddy4R.york
text: Flexible aggregation periods - def.avg() determines files relevant user defined aggregation period inputs can stored time bins e.g. files organised 30 min files, user wishes calculate fluxes hourly, correct files loaded occur. Support double rotation - wrap.rot() implements double rotation wraps existing planar fit capability. Additionally allows sector time based changes planar fit coefficients. Options restrict time lag ranges via wrap.lag(). Error catching logging

title: eddy4R.york
text: eddy4R.york uses parameters list created using def.para(). main input wrap.towr() defines settings calculation. Creating configuration looks like: set run calculate hourly fluxes CO2 O3 well sensible latent heat. use using linear detrending, double rotation perform lag correction scalars relative vertical wind. determined lag falls ranges supplied per scalar, fixed lag used instead.

title: eddy4R.york
text: wrap.towr() function contains possible steps workflow configured .def.para(). consists initial steps, loop around flux aggregation periods defined: Determine aggregation periods - def.avg() Read input data - read_input() Validity Checks - def.valid.input() Anemometer Corrections - wrap.anem.cor() Despiking - wrap.despike() Lag Correction - wrap.lag() Rotation Wind Vectors - wrap.rot() Calculate Fluxes - eddy4R.turb::wrap.flux() Stationarity Testing - eddy4R.turb::def.stna() Integrated Turbulence Characteristics - eddy4R.turb::def.itc() Integral Length Scales - wrap.isca() Random Systematic Errors - eddy4R.turb::def.ucrt.samp() Limits Detection - def.lod() Write files - write.REYN()

title: Definition function: Lag two datasets, so as to maximise their cross-correlation — def.lag2
text: refe vector variable reference time frame. class numeric. (-) meas vector variable time frame adjusted. class numeric. (-) freq Acquisition frequency refe meas. class ingeter. (Hz) freqThsh cutoff frequency low end high pass filter. Defaults 1 / (2 * lagMax / freq), eddy4r.base::def.lag() (Hz) dataRefe matrix data.frame data carries time frame refe. Defaults refe. class. (-) dataMeas matrix data.frame data carries time frame meas. Defaults meas. class. (-) measVar vector specifying several columns dataMeas shall lagged. Defaults NULL. class integer character. (-) lagMax Maximum lag, default 2 x freq. class integer. (-) lagCnst TRUE - interpret lagMax maximum permissible lag; FALSE - start lagMax first estimate increase iteratively. Defaults TRUE. class logical. (-) lagNgtvPstv "n" - consider negative lag times , .e. meas expected lag behind refe; "p" - consider positive lag times , .e. refe expected lag behind meas; "np" - consider negative positive lag times. Defaults "np". class character. (-) lagAll TRUE - consider positive negative correlations finding lag time; FALSE - consider positive correlations finding lag time. Defaults TRUE. class logical. (-) hpf TRUE - apply Butterworth high-pass filter; FALSE - use raw data. Defaults TRUE. class logical. (-) fracMin Minimum fraction data attempt lag determination. Defaults 0.1. class numeric. (-)
